findings.fix: Define the character action `G →* Equiv.Perm (N →* Kˣ)` from `MulAut.conjNormal` and `MulEquiv.monoidHomCongrLeftEquiv` first, then obtain `nonzeroJointWeightAction` by restricting it along the invariant predicate with `Equiv.Perm.subtypePerm`.
findings.issue: `nonzeroJointWeightAction` is the only form in which the conjugation action on characters is recorded, but the action laws proved in `map_one'`/`map_mul'` are entirely independent of `ρ`, `K`-module structure and weight spaces; the ρ-free action `G →* Equiv.Perm (N →* Kˣ)` is unavailable to users, and the special case is proved instead of the general one.

summary: The transport results are stated only for characters `N →* Kˣ` although their proofs use no multiplicativity, and the pointwise conjugation-of-eigenspace fact (which is where the content lives) is never isolated; the permutation action likewise bundles a ρ-independent action with the weight-space subtype.
